$comment: One deployment of CircleChat and the Recursica agents. Copy to $CC_DIR/site.json (outside
any repository) and fill it in. Secrets never go here: each stack's secrets live in the stack's
GitHub environment, and the secrets helper writes them on each computer (circlechat/README.md).
nodes: every machine that runs something. Add as many as you have. 'address' is how the
CONTROL node's containers reach that machine: a VPN/Tailscale address or name, or
host.docker.internal for the control machine itself.
exactly one node has "control": true. It runs CircleChat, the agents and the gateway.
Any machine can be the control node, a Mac or a PC of any size (Windows runs it through WSL).
routes: a name agents ask for, mapped to an ordered list of backends. The gateway tries
them in order, so the last entry is the fallback. A backend is "<node>/<model id>": a route
lists only the cluster's own models. A cloud model never joins a route.
jobs: a node with a jobs block runs a job runner (circlechat/jobd) for long, heavy agent work,
such as Porter's adapter ports. Each job gets memory_gb of memory at most; slots jobs run at once.
porter: the release Porter watches, the adapters it ports to, and who it mentions with a result.
site.tenant, site.kind, site.preview_port, site.gateway_port, site.docker_context: one stack per
client on a shared computer. Leave them out for a single stack. A client stack sets kind "client",
its own tenant name and ports, and its own Docker VM; see circlechat/README.md, "Clients".
tailnet_address: the control node's Tailscale IP address. Port jobs on other nodes reach the
model gateway there.
model_keys: the stack's cloud keys. Each named key records the provider, the cloud model and the
agents that use the key. The key's value lives only in the stack's GitHub environment, as
MODEL_KEY_<NAME> (MODEL_KEY_DEFAULT for the key named default). An agent no key names uses the
key named default. A task's "Cloud models" setting decides when a cloud key answers.
agents: each agent's routes (all routes when left out) and cloud switch (on when left out). With
the switch off, the gateway never calls a cloud model for the agent.

services.name: kev-engine
services.command: uv run --no-sync --extra serve python -m kev.serve --run jaredpalmer/kev-4b --port 8009 --host 0.0.0.0
